title: Anti Villager Abuse System
description: A.V.A.S  is a Minecraft plugin designed to prevent players from exploiting the villager re-roll mechanic.Once a villager acquires a profession, they retain it even if their workstation is removed and replaced. This ensures a more balanced and fair gameplay
body: When a player interacts with a villager and the villager acquires a profession, removing and replacing the villager's workstation will no longer cause the villager to change their profession. This mechanic helps maintain a consistent and fair trading system within the game.
